fields.label: Org Name
fields.help: The target org's name (see the Orgs tab).

fields.label: Task
fields.help: Initial message/goal override for this run. Supports {{$json.field}} placeholders.

fields.label: Output Key
fields.help: Where the org's run report is stored on the output item once the boss role signals completion.

fields.label: Wait For Completion
fields.help: Off: continue as soon as the run has started.

fields.label: Exclusive
fields.help: On: fail instead of joining when the org is already running a run this workflow did not start.
